source_snapshot.procedure: With amdgpu loaded and all devices visible, run amd-smi list.
source_snapshot.criteria: Eight GPU entries expose index, BDF, UUID, KFD_ID, NODE_ID and PARTITION_ID; sample BDF/UUID values may vary.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct read-only command but no expected inventory or identity reconciliation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves the source field coverage and correctly treats sample identifiers as nonliteral.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row430 checks AGFHC PCIe link status; row432 flashes E1.S firmware.

original_test_intent: Confirm the AMD driver exposes every expected GPU and that amd-smi reports a complete, internally consistent index/BDF/UUID/KFD node/partition identity for each device.
original_method: Pin amd-smi/ROCm/driver version; capture expected GPU serial/UUID/BDF and topology from authoritative inventory; mark log start; run amd-smi list with full output and exit status; parse every entry; compare set membership, uniqueness and KFD/NODE/PARTITION relationships; cross-check lspci/KFD sysfs without treating example values as fixed; inspect new driver/RAS errors.
manual_activity: Engineer provides the platform-specific expected GPU identity/topology and adjudicates any missing or duplicate device.
required_inputs: Expected partition mode and KFD node mapping
safety_requirements: Do not hard-code sample UUID/BDF values
Stop on GPU disappearance or driver instability
No automatic retry masking transient enumeration
engineer_actions: Approve expected map and partition mode

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal read-only command fits, but its result needs a user-approved identity oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `amd-smi list 2>&1`, record exit/timestamp, and reconcile every field with lspci/KFD sysfs and the approved inventory.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All listed identity fields and eight-entry coverage retained; example values remain variable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare identity sets keyed by stable UUID/serial/BDF rather than ordering, and validate uniqueness plus KFD relationships.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative expected set, cross-source mapping and bounded log delta.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Seeing eight indexes is insufficient if an expected GPU is replaced, duplicated or mapped to the wrong node.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDF/index/KFD identifiers can change across firmware or partition mode; expected stable and dynamic fields must be explicitly separated.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines stable identifier, permitted BDF/index changes, expected partition mode, whether all eight devices are mandatory and which driver warnings are acceptable.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek and Master both specify the same read-only amd-smi inventory; DeepSeek is only incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by tool/driver package and project-specific expected identity matrix.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row431 Wistron-AMD GPU-00142-V002: approve amd-smi/ROCm/driver versions, expected GPU count and stable serial/UUID/BDF/root-port map, permitted dynamic BDF/index/KFD changes, NODE_ID/PARTITION_ID mode and driver/RAS discrepancy policy.

review_improvement: Changes an example-output eyeball check into a stable identity-set and relationship validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source explicitly says BDF and UUID may vary, so matching literal samples would be wrong. Conversely, index count alone cannot detect replacement or duplicate identity; stable project inventory and independent PCI/KFD views are needed.
